mission: collector-redeploy ops-write runbook (owner GO 2026-10-22 08:44Z, 'go runbook'): after the Postgres password was rotated following Railway's 2026-10-21 security incident, every collector keeps the old password until a new deployment. Railway's dashboard offers only 'Deploy latest commit' on a collector, which builds from the branch and loses the verified upload. The runbook redeploys each of the 10 collectors on the image its newest rollout receipt recorded, via collector_variables.restore with a no-op APP_ENV=staging: no build, no code change, digest, schedule, start command and read-back checked, stops at the first failure. Dry run by default; apply needs the dry run's plan_sha256 and the owner's staging-ops approval.

impacts.reason: New runbook module: plan from fleet.DEFAULT_RECEIPTS (commit, digest per collector), redeploy source via collector_variables.original_source, plan_sha256 over service, commit, digest and live deployment; apply calls collector_variables.restore(name, {APP_ENV: staging}, commit, digest) in name order, stops at the first failure or the 02:00-06:00 UTC window. Reuses the existing verified-upload path; adds no Railway variable write of its own.
RUNBOOKS gains collector-redeploy as a collector-affecting write (ops-write only, owner approval, quiet windows, no delivery in progress). Refuses a count.
runbook choice collector-redeploy; expected_sha256 description and header comment. No job, gate, secret or permission change.

Registration and windows, count refused, plan from the committed receipt chain (snkrdunk a504e47, 9 shards 2bcbe90), missing source and missing service, plan SHA pins the live deployment, apply order and stop at first failure, stop before the quiet window, the no-op value is an allowed collector variable.
collector-redeploy section; it is not a collector release.

routes: Railway GraphQL deploymentRedeploy(usePreviousImageTag:true) on the receipt image only, through collector_variables.restore
impact.deployment_impact: No collector release, no code change on any collector, no RAW migration. Merging this PR changes nothing live; only an owner-approved ops-write apply redeploys, on the same image digests.

recovery.procedure: A failed collector stays on or returns to its receipt image (restore re-checks the digest); rerun the dry run, or restore one collector with scripts/collector_variables.py --restore --expect-digest <receipt digest>. Code revert: native revert PR with its own mission file.
recovery.trigger: A redeployed digest differs from the receipt, a schedule or start command changes, or a collector fails its next cron run.
recovery.backup: Not applicable: no schema or row change.

verification.observation_window: The owner-approved dry run, the apply, then the next cron run of each collector and a db-diagnostic/staging-state read.
